commit.message:
Check bar semantics for the selected Unix collector

The macOS native run correctly selected the portable backend through its Bash launcher, but the new regression test assumed every Bash launcher used Linux's enhanced collector. Assert the available/used quantity explicitly named in the output instead. Dispatch remains covered by separate compatibility tests.

No runtime, generator or generated artifact changes. The eight focused runtime tests pass on Linux, and the corrected metric contract also passes using actual Bash 3.2.0. Retain the initial macOS failure and rerun native CI for this test correction.
